overview: Premium redesign of Liza Espacio Belleza, a Chilean beauty studio in Providencia, with classified services, scarcity cupos, combos, a worker team section, a deep services page, and an informational Únete recruitment page for beauty professionals.
features: Prism-accented premium design with black glass cards and scroll animations
Hero landing without place photo using typography and iridescent gradients
Services classified by type with limited cupos counters (4/6/12)
Three combos and promotions for new clients and through December
Team section with prism-styled silhouettes and introductions
Deep Todos los Servicios page with techniques, tools, and promotional products
Únete page explaining the professional protocol, fees, and commissions with an application form
Partners banner featuring Flow for easy payments
Navbar with a cute prism detail and Spanish (Chile) content throughout
